findings.title: Broker construction failure strands its exclusive ledger lock
findings.trigger: Existing malformed JSON, unreadable ledger or invalid ledger schema after exclusive lock acquisition
findings.actual: createBroker rejects before returning a server; boot shutdown has no server reference and cannot release the lock. A corrected same-process restart rejects EEXIST.
findings.impact: Recoverable startup error requires manual stale-lock cleanup and leaves the opened file handle outside cleanup.
findings.evidence: independent.test.mjs imports actual frozen boot and broker; invalid-schema rejection, retained lock, corrected-ledger EEXIST all observed without listen or network
findings.remedy: Cover all initialization after successful lock acquisition with try/finally or catch that closes the handle and releases the owned lock on failure; preserve deliberate crash fail-closed policy.
